issues.detail: The second reply_not_matches, `(approve|confirm|authori[sz]e)[^?]{0,120}(scenario|budget|allowance|limit)[^?]{0,80}[?]`, can fail a correct run. A Tester that reports the blocker it cleared might quote it, for example "Cleared BlockedOn ('Approve two additional scenarios for src/export.ts?')". That quote matches the regex. So would "Approved allowance: +2 scenarios for src/export.ts ..." if any question follows within 80 characters. Neither reply repeats the approval request. The assertion is already complete:false, so the judge can decide whether approval was asked again.
issues.fix: In tester-12/spec.json, checks[assertion 2].all: delete the reply_not_matches object whose regex begins `(approve|confirm|authori[sz]e)`. Keep the BlockedOn equals NONE check and the run-tests reply_not_matches.
